developer_quote: It turns out that hci_conn_get_phy() is not in any way relying on hdev being immutable during the runtime of this function, neither does it even look at any of the members of hdev, and as such there is no need to hold that lock.
diff_summary: Removed hci_dev_lock/unlock pair around read-only phy queries.
verification_notes: SHA retrouve directement sur le depot source (auteur Jiri Kosina), message identique mot pour mot. Aussi confirme via NVD/CVE-2021-47038.

developer_quote: The serial core framework calls .stop_tx() and .start_tx() callbacks with port->lock held... rx_enable() and rx_disable() unconditionally acquire port->lock again. Since spinlocks are non-recursive, attempting to re-acquire the lock results in a deadlock. Remove the redundant port lock acquisition.
diff_summary: Removed redundant port->lock acquisition in rx_enable/rx_disable already held by caller.
verification_notes: Confirme via CVE-2026-64528, message et fonction exacts.

developer_quote: In commit 2a48fc0a ('block: autoconvert trivial BKL users to private mutex'), Arnd replaced the BKL usage with a mutex. However, Maxim has already provided a better fix in commit 480792b7 ('mtd: blktrans: kill BKL'), which was simply to remove the BKL without replacing it, since he'd already made it do all necessary locking for itself.
diff_summary: Removed redundant open_mutex made unnecessary by an earlier commit that already handled per-device synchronization.
verification_notes: Date (30 oct. 2010), auteur (David Woodhouse) et message confirmes. Suppression de open_mutex redondant avec la synchronisation interne MTD.
